_comment: Words only for the public 'How we score' pages: no scores, weights, anchors or thresholds. Every one of those comes from the config files the engine uses (football_v1.json, padel_v1.json, cricket_v1.json, card_tiers.json). Padel and cricket notes and sources come from their configs; football's config must stay identical to the Python engine's, so its notes live here.

football.notes: Interim: the manual-test norms are approximate, research-based and for adult men. They will be replaced with sourced or local data. VALD tests use VALD's own age-and-sex bands.

sources.ruler_drop: Davis (2000) rating bands for the ruler drop test (16-19 years, general population).

tests.sprint_10m: How quickly the athlete gets going: a 10 metre dash from a standing start.
tests.sprint_20m: Acceleration over 20 metres from a standing start.
tests.sprint_30m: Acceleration and top speed over 30 metres.
tests.ruler_drop: Reaction time: how far a dropped ruler falls before the athlete catches it.
tests.beep_test: Aerobic fitness: shuttle runs between two lines that get faster each level.
tests.yoyo_ir1: Repeated high-intensity running with short recoveries, the way matches feel.
tests.cod_505: Turning speed: sprint in, turn 180 degrees, sprint 5 metres out, timed through the turn.
tests.medicine_ball: Upper-body power: a seated two-handed chest throw with a 4 kg ball.
tests.single_leg_stand: Balance: how long the athlete can stand on each leg with eyes closed (HumanTrak).
tests.trunk_rotation: Mobility: how far the upper body turns to each side (HumanTrak).
tests.overhead_squat: Movement quality: a full squat with arms overhead, scored by HumanTrak.
tests.hip_extension: Strength of the muscles that drive the hip back (glutes and hamstrings), each side (Dynamo).
tests.knee_extension: Strength of the thigh muscles that straighten the knee (quads), each side (Dynamo).
tests.shoulder_er: Strength rotating the shoulder outwards, each side (Dynamo).
tests.shoulder_ir: Strength rotating the shoulder inwards, each side (Dynamo).
tests.elbow_extension: Strength straightening the elbow (triceps), each side (Dynamo).
tests.hip_abduction: Strength pushing the leg out to the side, each side (Dynamo).
tests.hip_adduction: Strength pulling the leg in (groin muscles), each side (Dynamo).

stats.speed: How fast the athlete accelerates and runs.
stats.power: How much force the athlete's muscles produce.
stats.agility: How quickly the athlete changes direction.
stats.endurance: How long the athlete keeps working hard.
stats.balance: How steady the athlete is on one leg.
